subject: math
title: Add Within 100 (Grade 1)
seo_title: Grade 1 Addition Within 100 Worksheets: Add Ones, Add Tens and Make a Ten
domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standard_text: Add within 100, including adding a two-digit number and a one-digit number, and adding a two-digit number and a multiple of 10, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate the strategy to a written method and explain the reasoning used. Understand that in adding two-digit numbers, one adds tens and tens, ones and ones; and sometimes it is necessary to compose a ten.
meta_desc: Free 1st grade addition within 100 worksheets: add a 1-digit number to a 2-digit number, add tens like 34 + 20, make a new ten with ten-frames and number lines, and short word problems. 100 practice questions with base-ten block pictures and an answer key.
key_big: Add ones to ones and tens to tens. 10 ones make 1 new ten.
key_sub: 23 + 4: add the 4 to the ones (27). 34 + 20: add the 2 tens to the tens (54). 38 + 5: 8 + 5 = 13 ones, so you get 1 new ten (43).
body_html:
Tens and ones

A 2-digit number has tens and ones. 23 is 2 tens and 3 ones. When you add, put ones with ones and tens with tens.

Add ones

Add the ones. The tens stay the same.

Add tens

20 is 2 tens. Add tens to tens. The ones stay the same.

Make a new ten

Sometimes the ones make 10 or more. Then 10 ones make 1 new ten.

Make a ten

What is 47 + 6?

47 needs 3 more to make 50. Take 3 from 6. 3 are left. 50 + 3 = 53.

Answer: 53

Add two 2-digit numbers

Add tens and tens. Add ones and ones. Then put them together.

Tens and ones

What is 24 + 35?

Tens: 20 + 30 = 50. Ones: 4 + 5 = 9. 50 + 9 = 59.

Answer: 59

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding ones to the tens: 23 + 4 = 634 is 4 ones. Add it to the 3 ones
Adding tens to the ones: 34 + 20 = 3620 is 2 tens. Add it to the 3 tens
Forgetting the new ten: 38 + 5 = 338 + 5 = 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones. Add the new ten
Writing 13 in the ones: 38 + 5 = 313Only one digit goes in the ones place
Adding all the digits: 23 + 4 = 9Keep tens and ones apart

faq.q: How do you teach adding within 100 in 1st grade?
faq.a: Use base-ten blocks: rods for tens and cubes for ones. Show that you add ones to ones and tens to tens, then write the same steps as numbers.

faq.q: How do you add a 2-digit and a 1-digit number, like 38 + 5?
faq.a: Make the next ten first: 38 + 2 = 40, then add the 3 that are left: 40 + 3 = 43. The 10 ones make 1 new ten.

faq.q: How do you add a multiple of 10, like 34 + 20?
faq.a: 20 is 2 tens, so add it to the tens: 3 tens + 2 tens = 5 tens. The ones do not change, so 34 + 20 = 54.

It is the Common Core standard for Grade 1: add within 100, including a 2-digit number plus a 1-digit number and a 2-digit number plus a multiple of 10, using models and place value. Children learn that sometimes 10 ones make a new ten.
